name: io.github.williansaez/abap-adt-mcp
description: ABAP development from Claude and other MCP hosts: source, transports, tests, ATC, debugger

environmentVariables.name: SAP_SYSTEMS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a JSON file mapping destination names to system configs (url, client, authType basic/sso/oauth, credentials). Recommended; keep the file mode 0600. See systems.example.json

environmentVariables.name: SAP_SYSTEMS
environmentVariables.description: Inline JSON map of destinations (same shape as SAP_SYSTEMS_FILE). Contains credentials — prefer SAP_SYSTEMS_FILE

environmentVariables.name: SAP_DEFAULT_DESTINATION
environmentVariables.description: Destination name used when a tool call omits `destination` (alternatively mark an entry with "default": true)

environmentVariables.name: SAP_AUTH_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: Default auth type for entries that don't specify one: sso (default), basic, or oauth

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: When set (1024-65535), serve Streamable HTTP on http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp with bearer-token auth instead of stdio

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind address for the HTTP transport (default 127.0.0.1). Set 0.0.0.0 only inside containers that publish the port

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for the HTTP transport; auto-generated and written to ~/.abap-adt-mcp/http-token when unset

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_MAX_SESSIONS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum concurrent MCP sessions on the HTTP transport (default 16); further initialize requests get 503

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_MAX_BODY_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Largest request body the HTTP transport accepts, in bytes (default 4194304); larger bodies are refused with HTTP 413

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_SESSION_TTL_MINUTES
environmentVariables.description: Idle minutes after which an HTTP session (and its SAP sessions/locks) is closed (default 30)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Origin values allowed on the HTTP transport (loopback origins always allowed when bound to loopback; * allows any)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Host header values allowed (DNS-rebinding protection; loopback hosts always allowed when bound to loopback)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EXPORT_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: When set, exportPackageSources may only write inside this directory

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUDIT_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path of a JSONL audit trail: one record per tool call (tool, destination, duration, outcome ok/error/denied/unavailable, policy gate, redacted argument summary)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to make every destination read-only (server-side; only read-only annotated tools plus login/logout run). Per-destination policies live in systems.json

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Toolsets to publish: comma list (core,source,objects,transports,analysis,tests,atc,data,discovery,runtime,refactoring,rap,services,git,debugger,traces) or a preset: all (default) or focused

environmentVariables.name: MCP_DISABLED_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Toolsets to hide, comma list (core cannot be disabled)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_MAX_RESPONSE_CHARS
environmentVariables.description: Character budget for a single tool response before results are paged/truncated (default 40000, minimum 5000). Raise it if your MCP host accepts larger tool outputs

environmentVariables.name: SAP_ALLOW_REENTRANCE_TICKET
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to enable the reentranceTicket tool (disabled by default: it returns a live SAP logon credential into the conversation)

environmentVariables.name: SAP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Legacy single-system mode: base URL of the SAP system, e.g. https://host:44300

environmentVariables.name: SAP_USER
environmentVariables.description: Legacy single-system mode: SAP username

environmentVariables.name: SAP_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Legacy single-system mode: SAP password

environmentVariables.name: SAP_CLIENT
environmentVariables.description: Legacy single-system mode: SAP client number, e.g. 100

environmentVariables.name: SAP_LANGUAGE
environmentVariables.description: Legacy single-system mode: logon language, e.g. EN

environmentVariables.name: SAP_BROWSER_PATH
environmentVariables.description: SSO destinations: path to a Chromium/Chrome/Edge binary for the browser login (auto-detected when unset)

environmentVariables.name: SAP_BROWSER_PROFILE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: SSO destinations: directory of the persistent browser profile that keeps the identity-provider session (default ~/.abap-adt-mcp/sso/<host>)

environmentVariables.name: SAP_TLS_INSECURE
environmentVariables.description: Legacy single-system mode: set to 1 to skip TLS certificate verification for that system only (sandboxes with self-signed certificates)

environmentVariables.name: SAP_OAUTH_TOKEN_URL
environmentVariables.description: Legacy single-system mode with SAP_AUTH_TYPE=oauth: OAuth2 token endpoint (client_credentials)

environmentVariables.name: SAP_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Legacy single-system mode with SAP_AUTH_TYPE=oauth: OAuth2 client id

environmentVariables.name: SAP_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Legacy single-system mode with SAP_AUTH_TYPE=oauth: OAuth2 client secret

environmentVariables.name: SAP_OAUTH_SCOPE
environmentVariables.description: Legacy single-system mode with SAP_AUTH_TYPE=oauth: optional OAuth2 scope

environmentVariables.name: MCP_PROFILE_GATE
environmentVariables.description: Platform gate for toolsets the destination does not expose (debugger, traces, abapGit, ...): enforce (default, refuse before calling SAP), warn (log only) or off

environmentVariables.name: MCP_SOURCE_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Lifetime of the per-session source cache used by grepPackage, cdsViewInfo and syntaxCheckCode (default 300; 0 keeps entries until logout)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the cached SAP cloudification repository used by apiReleaseState (default ~/.abap-adt-mcp/cache)
